observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a white, bumpy-textured foam block standing upright on a light wooden surface, against a dark background of acoustic foam panels. A dark metal-bladed tool (resembling a hot knife or soldering iron) is pressed into the right face of the block, already partway inside a notch. Over the excerpt the tool's blade travels downward through the block, and a vertical slot is carved. Faint smoke begins to rise from the cut area in the later frames, and a reddish handle portion of the tool appears at the right edge.
visible_changes: The dark tool blade shifts downward relative to the white block, extending the cut from a small upper notch into a longer vertical groove.
The cut opening on the block's right side widens/deepens toward the bottom as the blade passes.
Thin smoke becomes visible rising from the top of the cut region in the latter half of the clip.
A red object (likely the tool's handle) enters view at the right edge in later frames.
The block itself stays in place on the wooden surface; the camera and background remain essentially fixed.
outside_clip_unknowns: The moment the tool first contacted the block and the depth already cut before frame 1.
Whether the cut is completed or the tool is withdrawn after frame 41.
The exact material of the block and the tool's heating state.
uncertain_details: The tool type and material are not confirmed; it looks like a heated metal blade but could be a cold cutter.
It is the tool that moves, not the block, based on the block's static position and the changing cut.
Smoke onset timing is approximate; it is faint and not present in early frames.
